title: Measurement-aware identification of 48-hour acute kidney injury persistence
description: Reproducible phenotype specification, database mappings, statistical scripts, synthetic tests, and non-disclosive aggregate results for interval-defined 48-hour persistence of creatinine-defined acute kidney injury across MIMIC-IV v3.1, SICdb v1.0.8, and eICU-CRD v2.0. Version 1.2.1 is a portable reproducibility release: it aligns runtime source-path configuration with the documented environment variables, validates all published command-line entry points in continuous integration, records the frozen execution dependencies, and updates aggregate-result provenance. It retains the v1.2 analysis corrections that separate index-AKI search from recovery follow-up, re-anchor the SICdb coverage endpoint to first ICU bed assignment, and anchor controlled thinning to the original index episode. No restricted patient-level, episode-level, hospital-identifying, or trajectory-cache data are included.
